concept.description: Labels the scanned JDK artifact as :Jdk, identified by the fact that it declares java.lang.Object.
concept.cypher: MATCH (a:Java:Artifact)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Java:Type {fqn: 'java.lang.Object'}) SET a:Jdk RETURN count(a) AS jdkArtifacts

concept.description: Links every unresolved placeholder type to the super class of its JDK counterpart, so EXTENDS* reaches java.lang.Object from anywhere.
concept.cypher: MATCH (:Jdk)-[:CONTAINS]->(jdk:Java:Type)-[:EXTENDS]->(jdkSuper:Java:Type) MATCH (local:Java:Type {fqn: jdk.fqn}) WHERE local <> jdk AND NOT (local)-[:EXTENDS]->() MERGE (local)-[r:EXTENDS]->(jdkSuper) ON CREATE SET r.jdkResolved = true RETURN count(r) AS resolvedSuperClasses

concept.description: Same for implemented interfaces, so questions like "which types are Serializable" work across artifacts.
concept.cypher: MATCH (:Jdk)-[:CONTAINS]->(jdk:Java:Type)-[:IMPLEMENTS]->(jdkIface:Java:Type) MATCH (local:Java:Type {fqn: jdk.fqn}) WHERE local <> jdk AND NOT (local)-[:IMPLEMENTS]->() MERGE (local)-[r:IMPLEMENTS]->(jdkIface) ON CREATE SET r.jdkResolved = true RETURN count(r) AS resolvedInterfaces
